senses.gloss: f. (denom. of פָּסוּל) condition of unfitness, disqualification, opp. כשרות.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 128a:11">B. Bath. 128ᵃ</cite> <he>כל שתחילתו או סופו בפ׳ וכ׳</he> testimony for which the witness was disqualified at the beginning (when the fact to be attested occurred), or is disqualified at the end (when the evidence is taken) is illegal.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 9:7:1">Koh. R. to IX, 7</cite> <he>שמא פ׳ היה בבני</he> there was perhaps a defect in my son which made him rejectable as an offering.
